description: This file contains the source code for the Opencart Admin Controller class for managing SEO URLs. It includes methods for listing, editing, and filtering SEO URLs within the OpenCart admin interface. The class extends a core controller and interacts with models for fetching and manipulating SEO URL data. It also manages request parameters, breadcrumbs, and view rendering.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: Controller class for managing SEO URL entities in the admin panel of OpenCart.

methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the SEO URL management page with filters and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the list view of SEO URLs, echoing the output of getList method.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the list of SEO URLs based on filter parameters and search criteria.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing an SEO URL, pre-filling data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of a new or existing SEO URL, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected SEO URLs based on user selection, with permission checks.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the SEO URL data, typically syncing or recalculating all SEO URLs.
